description: Append 1 or 2 text turns (each a role, user or assistant, and its content) to a chat thread of an admin of your org (POST /chat/threads/:id/messages), the way the portal helper saves each exchange: each content is text of at most 32 KB with no data: URL; the thread's message_count and preview update and GET /chat/threads/:id reads them back in order. A receipted ledger event (the content hashed) is written first. Write tier.

messages.description: 1-2 turns in order, usually the user message then the assistant reply

name: tascan_append_chat_messages
